claim_scope.purpose: Receipt-gated Vulkan and OpenGL CTS qualification of Zink over the Venus/KosmicKrisp path; not a Khronos conformance submission or claim.

patches.subject: vulkan: bound memory-image copy address ranges to the buffer

resources.verified_against: CTS build Vulkan runtime archive including authenticated video samples

patches.subject: venus: size a host image copy from a describable format
venus: stop advertising DRM display acquisition
venus: expose host-backed guest memory fds
zink: support Venus implicit native dma-bufs
venus: consume paired protocol headers from an explicit build directory
venus: forward device address and maintenance commands
gallium: preserve integer blit output types in NIR
mesa/st: store integer pixel transfers without a blit
gallium: return NULL for failed threaded buffer maps
mesa/st: delete only a pixel-transfer specialization that was compiled
vulkan/wsi/x11: bound the swapchain event wait
vulkan/wsi/wayland: bound the waits a compositor need not end
venus: serve reference-counted layouts from the caller's allocator

mustpass.coverage_semantics: Execute every ordered top-level leaf exactly once; CTS-native N/M fractions each include the complete mandatory list, whose duplicates are de-duplicated by exact case name during coverage verification.
